oracle: projects/xml/c/libnxml/oracle.py (Python expat without namespace processing, ordered attributes)
output_name_form: raw qualified names (prefix:local); xmlns/xmlns:* are ordinary attributes
api: nxml_new(&doc); nxml_parse_buffer(doc, copy of the local bytes, size); walk doc->data and each nxml_data_t's children/next with type, value, ns and the attributes list (name, value, ns); nxml_free(doc)
namespace_semantics: libnxml 0.18.6 runs its own namespace pass after every parse (nxml_namespace.c): it records xmlns/xmlns:p declarations, removes a bound prefix from element and attribute names and points ns at the declaration. That pass also binds unprefixed attributes to the default namespace, contrary to Namespaces in XML, so expanded names are not claimed. harness.c reports qualified names by re-joining libnxml's stored prefix and local name; xmlns attributes stay in the attribute list.
coverage: LLVM source coverage of libnxml built out of tree from the pinned tag (static libnxml.a; shared library disabled)
coverage_limit: Two valid UTF-8 XML 1.0 controls without DOCTYPE establish libnxml's element, attribute, comment, processing-instruction, CDATA and text tree for them only, as a raw-name path: qualified names, xmlns attributes, attribute order and decoded values, depth and trimmed text runs. libnxml collapses whitespace runs inside text by default (the controls' text has single spaces). No namespace URI, expanded name or in-scope binding is reported. libnxml links libcurl for nxml_parse_url; the harness never calls it. DTDs, entities beyond the controls' references, other encodings, XML 1.1 and well-formedness rejection are not established. The expected outputs come from oracle.py (Python pyexpat in non-namespace mode, a different family from libnxml).
